notes.title: [NEWS] New Patreon goal for 1.7.0 and next major versions
notes.content:
Hello there! Some news coming up.
[h2]A huge thank you[/h2]
First of all, I wanna say [b]a huge thank you to all the people that are/were Patrons in Patreon and/or bought the commercial edition on Steam[/b]! Thanks to that, I was able to keep focusing longer on development and make the engine grow more and more!

I also want to say thank you to people that are active in the community by helping other people and sharing their creations!

 
[h2]Patreon goals and new versions[/h2]
However, it's getting harder and harder to keep being 100% on development with these earnings. As you may know, I'm the only developer on this project and being able to [b]hire someone to speed up all the development[/b] is one of my plans. Nevertheless,[b] I'm currently unable to pay only myself[/b] so there's a need to gradually increase these earnings.

Here is now what will happen for next versions:
[list][*]Don't be affraid, [b]the engine will keep being free for non commecial use![/b][/*][*][b]Each new major version will need a Patreon goal[/b] to be speed up (made in 3 weeks)[/*][/list]
 

For example, for [b]the next 1.7.0 version[/b], the speed up development will be started only after reaching a [b]$300 goal [/b]on Patreon. As long as the goal isn't reached, I won't progress on development but focus on communication to bring more people into the engine, work on future DLCs assets, and support and bug fixes. If the goal is reached before the end of 1.6.X, this version would be speed up too!

The next goals will be different amounts in order to gradually increase the earnings.

 
[h2]Get advantages from being a Patron![/h2]
Also, [b]note that you have a lot of advantages when becoming a Patron:[/b]
[list][*]You can receive gifts (reduced price on commercial edition and future DLCs assets Steam keys) according to your total $[/*][*]According to the tier you choose, you can have some special advantages (higher influence on next features, your games being showcased, your logo in the engine splashscreen...)[/*][/list]
 
[h2][url=https://www.patreon.com/bePatron?u=14575421]BECOME A PATRON![/url][/h2]

[h2]The new features for 1.7.0[/h2]
Here are the new features that will come for 1.7.0 if we reach a $300 goal:
[list][*]Command enter a name menu[*]Main menu customization[*]Troops battle reactions[*]Object states: options (through, stop animation, direction fix, keep position)[*]Custom fonts[*]Random battles in map properties[*]Base equipment heroes[*]Characteristics for classes[*]Language manager[*]Command create object in map[*]Command move object (complete)[*]Command change status[*]Command input a number[*]Command reset camera[*]Command change battle music[*]Command change victory music[*]Command end battle[*]Items option: can't be sold[/list]

Thank you very much for being here in this exciting adventure, let's make awesome games with RPG Paper Maker!

Wano

notes.title: Clarification about Open source state and free steam version
notes.content:
You may have seen a lot of feedbacks on the "Free Open source" keywords used in the project description.

I want to clarify this all. Please note that it's an independant project with only one (but really motivated) developer on it!

[h1]Free[/h1]

Some people didn't understand that the engine was free for non commercial use. They expected to have a free access on Steam, and sugested to have a DLC for commercial version then (note: there is no difference of content, this only allows you to publish your commercial games). 

I contacted Steam support to see if that's possible to do that and also offer DLC automatically for users that already bought the engine on Steam. This operation will be done as soon as possible.

Until the free Steam release, you can have access to the free version through the offical website here: [url=http://rpg-paper-maker.com/index.php/downloads]http://rpg-paper-maker.com/index.php/downloads[/url].

[h1]Open source[/h1]

The engine is using licence LGPLv3 + some parts of the Javascript code are proprietary. This is the current state, but it seems like this doesn't match with the Open source philosophy. That's why I asked to the discord community if it was morally OK to [b]go to a proprietary licence instead[/b]. The 1.2.0 version will always have LGPLv3 open source licence and can't be removed, but the next coming updates will now become proprietary.

I would [b]not hide source code[/b], and [b]the engine would still be accessible freely for non commercial use[/b]. Free use is really important to me, and I confused it with open sourcing in the past.

[h1]Too high price, not enough features[/h1]

The price will not be reduced now since it can be accessible freely for non commercial use. The price also goes with regular coming updates. The product is not  completely finished. There will be much more assets and features coming up.

Proposing the engine for the commercial version now is completely assumed. The only problem here is that communication was bad around the free aspect of the project on Steam and I'm really sorry for that. I firstly wanted to use Steam as a platform for selling some keys, and didn't expect people to wish the free version here too.

I apologize for all these confusions. 

Thank you all for your understanding and support,
Wano
